en: A black-and-white photograph of a large cargo or passenger ship docked in a harbor. The ship is decorated with maritime signal flags running from bow to stern. The vessel has the marking 'H S' on its funnel, and the name 'NORNES' is partially visible on the bow. The ship is reflected in the calm water, and there are some structures and cranes in the background, suggesting an industrial port setting.
